Name: Battle Royalley
Author: Ilyaki
Description:
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/q1imuomiztx4np2/BattleRoyalley.gif[/img]﻿
[i]^ High-level tactical gameplay

[youtube]K5IrjnwLRtc[/youtube][/i]

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/oeng51mznxi1crt/TheGame.png[/img]﻿

[list]
[*][size=3]Everyone will be scattered over Stardew Valley at the start of the game. [/size]
[*][size=3]You can find swords, slingshots, bombs, healing items and sometimes horses or even [i][b]hats[/b][/i] in chests spawned around the map.[/size]
[*][size=3]Chop trees and craft fences to use as cover.[/size]
[*][size=3]Hide behind trees/bushes/etc. for surprise attacks.[/size]
[*][size=3]The world border will gradually close in on a location.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Last farmer standing wins.[/b][/size]
[*][size=3]In spectator mode, press M and click on a map location to teleport your view there[/size]
[/list]
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/9vrnkiwuogqmgql/Installation.png[/img]﻿

[list=1]
[*]﻿Install SMAPI: [url=http://www.smapi.io]www.smapi.io[/url]﻿
[*]Unzip the BattleRoyalley.zip into your Stardew Valley folder. You should now have a folder Stardew Valley\Mods_BattleRoyalley
[*]When you want to play the mod, double click the [b]BattleRoyalley.bat[/b] file on Windows. On Linux run [b]BattleRoyalley.sh[/b]. On Mac run [b]BattleRoyalley.command[/b].
[size=2] ~ If you want to play the vanilla game/your normal mods setup [size=1](not that you would ever want to anymore)[/size], launch the game however you usually would.
 ~ Do NOT play a normal save file with the mod installed; it may break your save.
[size=1] ~ If the scripts don't work on Mac/Linux, let me know. You can move the BattleRoyale from Mods_BattleRoyalley to Mods and launch SMAPI the usual way as a temporary fix.[/size]
[/size]
[*]Optional mods: Social Tab Patch, Server Browser. Install by dropping into Mods_BattleRoyalley
[/list]
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/7o33yem51kkq8ip/HowToPlay.png[/img]﻿

[list=1]
[*]Join a server with the mod installed. [color=#00ff00]Highly recommended to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3227/]Server Browser[/url]﻿ to find a server. (Remeber to place the Server Browser folder inside Mods_BattleRoyalley, not Mods.)[/color]


[*]Wait for the next round to start
[/list]
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/nlzpv7ld8u7980v/ServerHost.png[/img]﻿

[list=1]
[*]Install the Battle Royalley mod
[*]Host a Co-op world. You can use the world I provided in the files section, or use your own. You will probably want to create a world with the mines area, the railroad, and the beach bridge unlocked.
[*]Run [b]br_setNumberOfPlayerSlots <player slots>[/b], e.g. br_setNumberOfPlayerSlots 100 to set the number of player slots.
[*]Invite players by sharing your invite code, IP, or using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3227/]Server Browser[/url]﻿ mod.

[*]To start the game, press right control or run br_start in the SMAPI console.
[/list]
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/azjmux5yxphpglm/ServerConfig.png[/img]﻿

You can configure config.json, spawns.json, chests.json and stormPhases.json in the BattleRoyale mod directory.
 [b]config.json[/b]
  ~ Set [i]ShouldHostParticipate[/i] to false if you want the host player to afk all round.
  ~ Set [i]TimeInSecondsBetweenRounds[/i] to -1 if you want to disable auto starting rounds.
 [b]spawns.json[/b]
  ~ This file contains all the spawn locations for the players. To set a new one, just follow the pattern in the file.
    To find your tile location in game, press Right Alt. It will be pasted in the SMAPI console.
 [b]chests.json[/b]
  ~ Works the same as spawns.json, but for chest spawn placements. Note that chests will not always spawn. The amount of chest that spawns depends on the amount of online players.
 [b]stormPhases.json[/b]
  ~ During the game, multiple storm (the yellow cloud) phases will run consecutively.
  ~ Each phase contains multiple game locations (e.g. the Mayor's house) that will cover from 0% to 100% in the duration of the phase.
  ~ After each phase, there is a delay before the next phase begins.
  ~ In stormPhases.json you can create as many phases as you like, with delays, durations and their list of locations.
  ~ For CloseIn rectangles, X1/Y1 [b]must[/b] be the top left corner and X2/Y2 [b]must[/b] be the bottom right corner
